observations.detail: The first gate saved and opened the already-active target path. Identity and revision matched, but this did not exclude a same-path no-op.

After saving a distinct intermediary model, Sketchup.open_file returned load status 0 for the target while the queue callback still observed the intermediary model. The gate exited non-zero instead of claiming success.
The SketchUp UI showed the target model focused while the old queue timer still reported the intermediary document.

After closing only the saved intermediary window, source_path, geometry, materials, definitions, and persistent paths came from the target, but scenes and view_state still reported Save_Reopen_Intermediary_Scene.

required_fix: Route queue work through the model reported by macOS activation events instead of the callback's stale document context.
Persist and hydrate scenes, levels, view, style, shadow, rendering, and manifold sidecar state per SketchUp model.
Return an explicit pending MDI activation result without a snapshot from the wrong document.
Require target activation plus a fresh Session Contract before any later mutation.
Re-run the strong target-intermediary-target gate and require an empty zero-tolerance snapshot diff.
